behavior: One contextual panel retains work, exact session selection, questions, delivered results and authorized artifacts. No parallel runtime inventory.
Session-only targets have no invented operation. Multiple sessions require explicit selection; question/result selection binds its own exact session and controls.
Shared passive output viewer has one body, no nested terminal dialog/maximizer; contextual canonical controls fix all seven runtime dimensions and cannot start a replacement session.
Continue, interrupt-current-run and close are distinct reviewed intents. Unknown review/admission is recover-only, with same-ID receipts and no automatic replay.
Logout clears protected output/text; attempted controls retain a minimal quarantined recovery fence, including sibling intents, rather than becoming permission for a new action.
One existing modal guard protects context switches and drafts. Explicitly passive session selection does not fabricate a dirty form.
Connect agent opens the short flow from operational/classic Home and Conversations, preserving the existing introduction guide and internal view IDs.
Onboarding lists all bounded authorized catalog pages, revalidates Resume, proposes a distinct identity only at canonical Finish, uses dynamic presets/defaults and explicit model-test/Finish consent.
Remote onboarding explains browser/Server/Connector authority and uses the existing host-draft and operator review pipeline; no operator credential is copied to the host.
Home entries cursors now bind authenticated human identity separately from the operator actor; missing human context is denied. Existing authorization remains canonical.
